title: 小动物
intro: Pets, farm animals and zoo animals, and the first real measure-word system: 只 for most animals, 条 for long thin ones, 头 for big livestock, 匹 for horses. Three of the most famous Chinese nursery rhymes live here.

ex.p: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī māo
xiǎo māo xǐ huan chī yú
xiǎo gǒu hěn kě ài
wǒ pà dà gǒu

items.note: 鱼 yú sounds like 余 yú (surplus): a whole fish is served at New Year for 年年有余.

wǒ xǐ huan chī yú
niǎo huì fēi
shù shàng yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo
ex.en: There's a little bird in the tree.

ex.p: gōng jī zǎo shang jiào
ex.en: The rooster crows in the morning.

yā zi huì yóu
xiǎo yā zi gā gā jiào

items.en: (measure word for most animals, and one of a pair)
items.note: Also for one of a pair: 一只手, 一只鞋. Read zhǐ it means 'only' (trad 只).

ex.p: wǒ yǒu sān zhī xiǎo jī
zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu shì shéi de

items.en: (measure word for long, thin things: fish, snakes, dogs, roads, rivers, trousers)

ex.en: There are two fish in the river.

ex.p: nà tiáo gǒu hěn dà

items.note: Slang: 牛 / 很牛 = awesome, impressive.

items.note: Calling someone 猪 is teasing ('silly'), but affectionate between friends.

猫.h: Animal 犭 + 苗 miáo, which sounds like 'meow'.

狗.h: Animal 犭 + 句 for the sound.

鱼.h: Head on top, scaly body in the middle, tail at the bottom.

鸭.h: 甲 jiǎ (a 'ya' sound like a quack) + bird 鸟.

只.h: Traditional 隻 was a hand holding one bird: one animal.

条.h: A long branch of a tree 木.

羊.h: A sheep's face with curly horns on top.

猪.h: Animal 犭 + 者 for the sound.

兔.h: A crouching rabbit; the final dot is its fluffy tail.

老.h: An old man bent over a walking stick. A friendly prefix in 老虎, 老鼠, 老师.

虎.h: Tiger stripes 虍 over legs 几.

鼠.h: Teeth on top, claws and a long tail below.

松.h: Tree 木 + 公 for the sound. 松鼠 = pine mouse.

熊.h: 能 was originally a drawing of a bear; 灬 are its paws.

象.h: An elephant stood on end: trunk at the top, legs and tail below.

猴.h: Animal 犭 + 侯 hóu for the sound.

动.h: Clouds 云 pushed by force 力: move.

物.h: Ox 牛 + 勿 for the sound.

游.h: Water 氵 + a waving banner: swim, wander.

养.h: A sheep 羊 on top: raising animals.

可.h: A mouth 口 saying 'yes, you may'.

怕.h: A heart 忄 gone white 白 with fear.

尾.h: Hair 毛 at the back end of a body 尸: tail.

texts.title: 小白兔

lines.p: xiǎo bái tù bái yòu bái
lines.en: Little white rabbit, white as white,

lines.p: liǎng zhī ěr duo shù qǐ lái
ài chī luó bo ài chī cài
lines.en: loves to eat radishes, loves to eat greens,

lines.p: bèng bèng tiào tiào zhēn kě ài

notes: Kids hold two fingers up as ears while reciting.
白又白: 'white and white again', extra white. 竖起来: stand up straight. 蹦蹦跳跳: AABB doubling for lively movement.

texts.title: 两只老虎

lines.p: liǎng zhī lǎo hǔ liǎng zhī lǎo hǔ
pǎo de kuài pǎo de kuài
lines.en: run so fast, run so fast.

lines.p: yī zhī méi yǒu ěr duo
yī zhī méi yǒu wěi ba
zhēn qí guài zhēn qí guài

notes: Every Chinese child sings this to the tune of Frère Jacques.
跑得快: verb + 得 + how it's done. More on 得 in Stage 2.

texts.title: 小老鼠上灯台

lines.p: xiǎo lǎo shǔ shàng dēng tái
lines.en: Little mouse climbs up the lamp stand,

lines.p: tōu yóu chī xià bu lái
lines.en: steals the oil, can't get back down.

lines.p: miāo miāo miāo māo lái le
lines.en: Meow, meow, meow, here comes the cat,

lines.p: jī li gū lū gǔn xià lai

notes: 灯台: an old oil lamp stand; mice loved to steal the lamp oil.
下不来: 'can't get down' (potential complement, Stage 3). 叽里咕噜: the sound of something rolling.

exercises.why: Long, thin things (fish, snakes, roads, rivers) take 条.
Big beasts (cows, pigs, elephants) take 头.
Birds and most small animals take 只.
Animals take 只 (dogs also 条), not 个.

exercises.p: wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhī māo
hóu zi xǐ huan chī xiāng jiāo

exercises.why: 子 is a light noun suffix (tù zi). Not every animal takes it: just 猫.

scenario.title: 去动物园
scenario.setting: Saturday at the zoo with Dad.

a.npc: 动物园到了！你想先看什么动物？
a.p: dòng wù yuán dào le nǐ xiǎng xiān kàn shén me dòng wù
a.en: We're at the zoo! Which animal do you want to see first?

opts.en: I want to see the pandas!
I want to see the tigers.

opts.fb: Fine, but 我想看熊猫 is the full sentence.

b.npc: 你看，熊猫在吃竹子。有几只熊猫？
b.p: nǐ kàn xióng māo zài chī zhú zi yǒu jǐ zhī xióng māo
b.en: Look, the pandas are eating bamboo. How many are there?

opts.fb: Animals take 只: 两只熊猫.

c.p: lǎo hǔ hěn dà nǐ pà bù pà
c.en: The tiger's huge. Are you scared?

opts.fb: 有点儿 + unpleasant feeling = a bit.

d.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me dòng wù

opts.zh: 我最喜欢小狗，因为很可爱。
opts.p: wǒ zuì xǐ huan xiǎo gǒu yīn wèi hěn kě ài
opts.en: I like puppies best, because they're cute.

e.p: hǎo xià cì wǒ men zài lái
e.en: OK, we'll come again next time!
